ordering.selftestGate: round-5 correctness-gate hardening (benchmark/scoring path UNCHANGED from round-4): the regression suite is now gated the SAME way as the benchmark. The trusted parent draws a fresh 63-bit nonce and drives BOTH the candidate runner and the pristine /opt/target-seed reference with 'selftest <nonce>'; each runner folds every check's nonce-selected structural probes (parse-tree fingerprint/element+diagnostic counts/trimmed range/token kind+range+text for parse checks; full output bytes + nonce-selected byte probes for format checks) into a nonce-keyed FNV proof over the parent-owned stdout pipe, and the gate passes only when candidate proof == reference proof for that nonce. Replaces the round-4 candidate-forgeable frozen-receipt byte-compare (SELFTEST_RECEIPTS), which a candidate over-fit to the corpus but broken on a selftest-only construct could precompute offline. Verified gaming-resistant: a runner returning a precomputed proof for a guessed nonce is rejected (proof mismatch under the fresh nonce) while an honest runner passes. Confined to eval.py run_selftest + harness selftest_fold/fold_parse_probe/fold_format_probe/selftest_proof + the 'selftest' CLI arm.
ordering.measurementNote: round-4 hardening: (ADAPTER) iteration selection + per-iteration validation live in the trusted parent, never in a candidate-authored completion file — the parent draws a fresh per-sample nonce, drives both the candidate and the pristine /opt/target-seed reference with it, and each folds every timed iteration's protected probe observations into a nonce-keyed proof returned over the parent-owned stdout pipe; a sample counts only when the candidate proof equals the reference proof for that nonce, so a process that computed the base once and exited cannot be credited. (EST) score = manifest qBase anchor * geomean over workloads of the PAIRED per-batch reference/candidate wall-time ratio (candidate+reference legs in one batch run back-to-back against the same instantaneous host load), which cancels common-mode contention within each pair and tightened the A-A spread ~5x vs round-2 min-of-N. (NS) every timed leg runs in a fresh mount+IPC namespace with a brand-new /tmp, /dev/shm and /var/tmp; the untimed warmup uses a distinct nonce so it cannot satisfy a scored leg. (CG) peak RSS is the whole-tree kernel cgroup memory.peak. Between legs the evaluator (a subreaper) reaps every candidate-uid process and drains the measurement leaf.
